name: VC_Kerb_Straight_4m
collision_type: COL (non-convex MeshCollider) x2: dry_asphalt gutter + kerb face/top
pivot: start of the piece, at the road edge of the gutter pan, z = 0 = road surface
notes: 4.00 m module; 150 mm upstand + 25 mm chamfer + 450 mm gutter pan. Runs toward Unity +Z, kerb rises toward Unity +X. Surfaces: Kerb (face/top), Asphalt (pan).

name: VC_Kerb_Corner_90
collision_type: COL (non-convex MeshCollider) x2: dry_asphalt gutter + kerb face/top
pivot: start of the piece (same datum as VC_Kerb_Straight_4m)
notes: 90 deg kerb return, 3.00 m face radius, turning toward Unity +X (footway on the inside). The left-hand return is this piece mirrored on X.

name: VC_Kerb_DriveApron_4m
collision_type: COL (non-convex MeshCollider) x2: dry_asphalt gutter + kerb face/top
pivot: start of the piece (same datum as VC_Kerb_Straight_4m)
notes: 4.00 m dropped-kerb driveway apron: 0.80 m flare down, 2.40 m dropped crossing (30 mm upstand), 0.80 m flare up. Tiles between straight kerb modules.

name: VC_Drain_Inlet_Kerb
collision_type: COL (non-convex MeshCollider) x2: dry_asphalt gutter + kerb face/top (the gutter solid closes the sump)
pivot: start of the piece (same datum as VC_Kerb_Straight_4m)
notes: 1.20 m combination inlet: 0.90 m kerb throat (140 mm clear under a cast lintel) over a 0.90 x 0.42 m sump with a 7-bar cast grate. Collision closes the sump so wheels cannot drop in.

name: VC_Guardrail_WBeam_4m
pivot: start of the piece, post centreline, ground level (z = 0), rail back plane (x = 0)
notes: 4.00 m post-and-rail module, rail centre 550 mm, 1.85 m C-section post at the module start. The rail face looks toward Unity -X (the carriageway); the module runs toward Unity +Z. PITCH IS EXACTLY 4.00 m: the rail spans y = 0 to -4.00. The post, blockout and splice bolt straddle the start plane and reach 0.10 m BACK past it, which is deliberate - in a run that puts the splice post over the joint between two rails, as a real W-beam does. So the bounding length is 4.12 m but the placement pitch is 4.00 m; do not space them by the bbox.

name: VC_Guardrail_WBeam_End
pivot: start of the piece (mates with VC_Guardrail_WBeam_4m), ground level
notes: 4.00 m flared end terminal: the rail drops 550 -> 200 mm and flares 0.60 m away from the carriageway into an impact head and ground anchor.

name: VC_Barrier_Jersey_3m
pivot: base centre (centre of the 3.00 m length, cross-section centre, z = 0)
notes: 3.00 m NJ-type module, 815 mm high, 610 mm base, 156 mm top; the end 50 mm is inset 15 mm for the lap joint, so modules read as separate castings.

name: VC_Barrier_Jersey_EndTaper
pivot: base centre (centre of the 3.00 m length, cross-section centre, z = 0)
notes: 3.00 m tapered end: 815 -> 360 mm over the run, same NJ profile truncated. The full-height end (Blender +Y, Unity -Z) mates with VC_Barrier_Jersey_3m.

name: VC_Gantry_Truss_12m
pivot: start of the span, bottom-chord plane, truss centreline (x = y = z = 0)
notes: 12 m box-truss span, 0.90 m wide x 1.25 m deep, 110 mm chords. The span reaches toward Unity +X; set the pivot at the leg-top level (legs are 7.60 m, giving 6.35 m clear under a 4.80 x 2.40 m panel hung from the rails).

name: VC_Gantry_Truss_20m
pivot: start of the span, bottom-chord plane, truss centreline (x = y = z = 0)
notes: 20 m box-truss span, 0.90 m wide x 1.25 m deep, 110 mm chords. The span reaches toward Unity +X; set the pivot at the leg-top level (legs are 7.60 m, giving 6.35 m clear under a 4.80 x 2.40 m panel hung from the rails).

name: VC_Gantry_Leg_Lattice
pivot: base centre, z = 0 at the top of the foundation
notes: 7.60 m laced steel upright, 0.55 m square, 0.90 m base plate with four anchor bolts. Pairs with either gantry span.

name: VC_Gantry_Leg_Concrete
pivot: base centre, z = 0 at the top of the foundation
notes: 7.60 m tapered concrete upright (0.85 x 0.65 m at the plinth, 0.65 x 0.55 m at the capital) with lift-joint steps and a steel bearing plate at 7.84 m.

name: VC_SignPanel_Blank_4800x2400
pivot: TOP centre of the panel face - the panel hangs from the gantry rails, so the pivot is the hanger line, not the base centre (deliberate deviation)
notes: 4.80 x 2.40 m BLANK panel, 40 mm face, rear stiffeners and hanger brackets. No text or symbol geometry: Veyra's own signage is applied on the Unity side. The face looks toward Unity +Z.

name: VC_SignPanel_Blank_2400x1500
pivot: TOP centre of the panel face - the panel hangs from the gantry rails, so the pivot is the hanger line, not the base centre (deliberate deviation)
notes: 2.40 x 1.50 m BLANK panel, 40 mm face, rear stiffeners and hanger brackets. No text or symbol geometry: Veyra's own signage is applied on the Unity side. The face looks toward Unity +Z.

name: VC_SignalMast_Cantilever
pivot: base centre of the upright, z = 0 at the top of the foundation
notes: 7.00 m tapered upright (320 -> 240 mm) with a 5.50 m cantilever arm rising from 6.40 to 6.75 m. The arm reaches toward Unity +X; heads hang below it.

name: VC_Signal_Head_3
pivot: TOP centre of the mounting bracket - the head hangs from a mast arm, so the pivot is the mount point, not the base centre (deliberate deviation)
notes: 3-head housing, 1.16 m body + backplate, 300 mm lenses with visors. Lenses face Unity +Z (toward oncoming traffic). Under 2 m, so LOD0 + LOD1 only.

name: VC_UtilityPole_Timber
pivot: base centre at the ground line (z = 0); the butt continues to -0.10 m
notes: 11.00 m timber distribution pole, 290 -> 190 mm, one 2.45 m crossarm at 10.20 m with four pin insulators, a three-spool secondary rack at 8.95 m and pole steps. NO cables - the catenary is generated procedurally in Unity. Crossarm axis runs along Unity X.

name: VC_UtilityPole_Transmission
pivot: base centre at the ground line (z = 0); the butt continues to -0.10 m
notes: 14.50 m timber transmission-style pole, 350 -> 210 mm, 3.00 m upper arm at 13.60 m (three insulators) and 2.45 m lower arm at 12.30 m (four), plus an earth-wire spike. NO cables.
